newsitem.title: USA: SMT Health sees Q3 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: SMT Health sees Q3 EPS above estimates.

text.p: SMT Health Services Inc said Thursday it expects to earn between $0.19 to $0.21 a share in the third quarter ended September 30, which exceeds analysts' earnings estimates of $0.16 per share.
The company earned $0.14 a share a year ago.
Net income from operations will be about $0.17 to $0.19, including an after-tax adjustment of about $200,000 related to a sales tax refund, the company said.
The company also expects to record a deferred tax adjustment which will reduce its income tax provision approximately $200,000, or $0.02 per share, during the third quarter of 1996.
For the first nine months, SMT expects its net income To be between $0.48 to $0.50 a share, compared with $0.36 a year ago.
